subject: Post-call: procurement readiness & billing trigger options for Olive Tech trial
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Park <sara@olivetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: procurement readiness & billing trigger options for Olive Tech trial

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and a few asks so we can lock the trial activation and plan the billing handoff cleanly. High-level summary: Olive Tech is interested in a 30-day technical trial for search-rewrite and summarization flows backing two internal apps (Support Assist + Docs Summaries). Key constraints you mentioned: procurement requires a PO for anything >$5k/month, security team needs SOC2 evidence, and finance prefers marketplace purchase if feasible.

What we need to confirm to move to trial activation (please reply inline):
- Procurement path: do you have an AP contact and preferred PO template? If you need a vendor address/K1, we can provide immediately.
- Payment method: is Olive willing to start on corporate card for the 30-day technical trial (faster) or will you require a PO up-front? If PO, what’s your expected issuance timeline?
- Marketplace: are you open to buying via AWS Marketplace / Azure Marketplace to accelerate purchase/contract (we can provide rate-card + procurement checklist)?
- Trial success criteria: do the following look right? 1) 50k tokens/day for Support Assist with <=250ms median token latency; 2) 80% reduction in manual triage for sampled queries (measured by your CS team); 3) two production-like integrations running by day 21. If you prefer different numbers, note them.
- Billing start: would you prefer billing to begin on (A) first day after trial ends, (B) immediately after contract signature, or (C) on first production API call? We can support any of these but want to set expectations for invoicing.

I've attached a short SOW draft and our SOC2 attestation for the security team. Ben (cc'd) will follow up on pricing/payment flow options once you confirm the procurement path.

Next steps we propose:
1) You confirm procurement contact and preferred payment route by EOD Tue 22 Jun.
2) If PO required, Olive sends PO template — we return a countersigned SOW + invoice within 48 hours.
3) If card OK, we can flip the trial switch and schedule a short onboarding sync with Marissa to instrument success metrics.

Thanks — talk soon,

Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments:
- SOW_draft_v2.pdf (summary + trial acceptance criteria)
- SOC2_attestation.pdf (recent report stub)
From: Sara Park <sara@olivetech.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@olivetech.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement readiness & billing trigger options for Olive Tech trial

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers:
- Procurement contact: cc'ed Oliver will own PO / vendor onboarding. He asked for your vendor legal name + W-9 (can you send?).
- Payment method: Finance prefers a PO for anything above $5k/month; our Legal wants standard terms. We can cut a PO but it will take about 7 business days once we receive the SOW and vendor info.
- Marketplace: we would prefer to use AWS Marketplace if pricing and terms align — that tends to be faster for Finance. Do you publish an equivalent SKU there?
- Trial success criteria: the numbers look reasonable. We want to change the token threshold to 40k/day for the first 14 days ramp, then 60k/day as we open to more users. Also would like a measurable baseline for triage reduction — Marissa, can you propose an instrumentation checklist?
- Billing start: Finance will accept billing to begin on the first day after the trial ends and invoice against the PO.

We will send a short vendor packet and PO template by EOD Tue 22 Jun. In the meantime, could you send the W-9 and the marketplace SKU details?

Regards,
Sara
Head of Integrations, Olive Tech
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Park <sara@olivetech.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement readiness & billing trigger options for Olive Tech trial

Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few things I can action right away:
- Vendor info & tax: Vendor name is Redwood Inference, Inc.; W-9 and vendor packet attached (see SOW_draft_v2.pdf includes legal block) — I will also attach a separate W-9 to the shared Drive link.
- Marketplace SKU: we do have an AWS Marketplace listing. SKU: RW-INF-TRIAL-1. I added the marketplace purchase play and benefits below: faster PO reconciliation for Finance, consolidated billing to AWS, and auto-entitlement for the trial seat. If Olive wants Azure Marketplace instead, we can provide that SKU as well.
- PO process timing: understood about the ~7 business days. To keep momentum, if you can accept our standard SOW + PO, we will provision trial capacity as soon as the PO is issued and invoice per the PO terms. If you'd rather expedite on card, we can turn the trial on within 24 hours after card auth.
- Trial acceptance & metrics: Marissa — would you be able to propose the instrumentation checklist and a 3-point reporting cadence (day 7, 14, 28)? Sara suggested ramp thresholds; we can accept the 40k/60k cadence.

Next steps I will own: post the W-9 to the Drive link and kick off the DocuSign envelope for the SOW once we confirm the PO vs card route. Sara, if you send the PO template, I can pre-fill and return for signatures.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced:
- pricing-summary.xlsx (line-item breakout + marketplace rate equivalence)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Park <sara@olivetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 18:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement readiness & billing trigger options for Olive Tech trial

Thanks everyone — recording next steps here for clarity: 

1) Olive Tech (Sara / Oliver) to send PO template + vendor packet by EOD Tue 22 Jun (Oliver).
2) Redwood (Ben) will pre-fill the PO/SOW and post W-9 to the shared Drive; Ben will open a DocuSign envelope for signature once PO path is confirmed. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/envelopes/abc123-sign (shared).
3) Marissa will send an instrumentation checklist and reporting cadence (day 7/14/28) by Wed 23 Jun to measure triage reduction and latency targets.
4) Trial provisioning: will occur when PO is issued (estimated 7 business days) or immediately if Olive confirms card payment. Billing will start on first day after trial ends per Finance preference.

Open question for Olive: if procurement would like the marketplace flow, can you confirm AWS Marketplace purchase is acceptable before we create the SKU entitlement? This will minimize invoice reconciliation time for your Finance team.

I'll schedule a 30-minute onboarding session for the week after SOW signature to walk through telemetry and success tracking.

Thanks — Irene
